Name: Espresso Machine
Author: dragonsir
Description:
[size=5]May not be currently compatible with 1.6 Update:[/size]

I am currently working on all of my mods to make them compatible with 1.6. Please use at your own risk or wait until a compatible version is available.


[line]

Adds an craftable espresso maker that makes Triple-Shot Espresso.

Making espresso in real life requires a completely different process than just adding three cups of coffee together. So, this machine will do just that. Includes a small animation when the machine is working.

Time to brew is configurable through the config file.

[size=5]Installation[/size]

[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Install Json Assets.[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Install Producer Framework Mod (PFM).[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip this file into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
